messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected from gateway->inference.
service: inference-gateway-prod
path: /v1/generate
5m error rate: 11.8% (baseline 0.3%)

maria: Paging oncall SRE, i'm the oncall. assigning self. give me heads-up on customer impact.

ben-cs: seeing multiple customer p99 timeouts and a handful of live support tickets. shipping customers: payment pipelines and chat widgets.

sanjay: grafana: https://grafana.company/local/d/AI/inference-gateway?orgId=1&from=-5m
looks like spike aligns with a deploy 28m ago. retries and 502/504s spike together.

elaine: quick suspicion: envoy retry policy + route weight shuffle caused retry amplification -> upstream overload.
I can check envoy configs in k8s: ns=platform, svc=inference-gateway

maria: on it. first action: reduce retry-policy to 0 for the affected route to stop amplification. will also open route to fallback model.

sanjay: logs from ingress show repeated internal 503s with 'upstream connect error or disconnect' and circuit_breaker: overloads.
excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T10:23:11Z] proxy: retrying request id=... backend=mallory-02 status=503 attempt=3
[2026-03-15T10:23:12Z] envoy: upstream connect error: connection reset by peer
```

maria: applying patch to envoy route via k8s patch: 
```
kubectl -n platform patch envoyfilter inference-gw-retry --type merge -p '{"spec":{"config": {"route_config": {"retry_policy": {"per_try_timeout": "0s", "num_retries": 0}}}}}'
```

deploy-bot: Started rollout inference-gw-retry-patch by maria. Build: 83a1bf

maria: patch applied. asking observability to watch 5xx and p95 latency.

observability-bot: 5m window: errors down from 11.8% -> 3.2% (1m after patch). p95 latency decreased 220ms -> 90ms. will post updated panels.

elaine: nice, that confirms retry amplification. next: consider increasing circuit breaker threshold for short window and roll a canary with lower weight.

sanjay: temporary mitigation: reduce route weight to 0.1 for new model variant to limit fanout.
maria: doing weight change now via routing API:
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/routes/weight \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","weight_adjustment":{"model-canary":0.1}}'
```

deploy-bot: route-weight update succeeded.

ben-cs: customer tickets dropping, one customer reported degraded but recovering. i'll update support notes.

maria: marking incident as mitigated. remaining tasks: follow-up postmortem, check retry policy rollout process, add guard in control-plane to prevent retry+route-weight combos.

elaine: filing follow-up ticket: INF-4721 "prevent retry amplification during traffic shifts" and will link logs/dashboards.

maria: thanks team. incident closed for now, will keep monitoring for 2 hours. :thumbsup:
